{{Top|leg}}
'''Master Smiths''' were [[Togorian/Legends|Togorians]] [[bladesmith]]s who were exceptionally skilled in the art of forging the [[sc'rath]]. Young smiths are expected to study at the side of a master smith for years. [[Mlatar Thon Gra]] studied under Master [[Elotis]] and was awarded the title of master smith in the sixth year of his study.
